name: intraciliary transport
def: The bidirectional movement of large protein complexes along microtubules within a cilium, mediated by motor proteins.

name: intraciliary transport particle B
def: The larger subcomplex of the intraciliary transport particle; characterized complexes have molecular weights around 550 kDa.

name: intraciliary transport involved in cilium assembly
def: The bidirectional movement of large protein complexes along microtubules within a cilium that contributes to cilium assembly.

name: intraciliary anterograde transport
def: The directed movement of large protein complexes along microtubules from the cell body toward the tip of a cilium (also called flagellum), mediated by motor proteins.

name: intraciliary transport particle B binding
def: Binding to an intraciliary transport particle B (IFT B) complex.

name: non-motile cilium
def: A cilium which may have a variable array of axonemal microtubules but does not contain molecular motors.

name: photoreceptor connecting cilium
def: The portion of the photoreceptor cell cilium linking the photoreceptor inner and outer segments. It's considered to be equivalent to the ciliary transition zone.
